head: claude/port-P0257-ae30
title: Port P0257: 47 ready modules to Lean 4.36
body:
Refs #32733 (packet claim, kept open: this is a **partial** packet submission and P0257 remains incomplete).

Ports the 47 ready members of P0257 to the target in `port/target.json`:
- Lean `leanprover/lean4:v4.36.0` (`Lean (version 4.36.0, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, commit 611c117bfaf7b7ae1cfcf246ce6fba31e8f509e9, Release)`)
- Mathlib `fc4f59e577feb1a4956671bc04ac18aaaf8cd842`

5 modules patched, 42 unchanged. Statement changes (M086328, M090566) are only the dropped explicit ring argument of `MvPowerSeries.pderiv`; each has a notes entry arguing equivalence. Nothing touches `Main`, `Statements` or the public theorems.

## Commands run and results

1. `python3 tracker/port_build.py prepare WORK` (elan's own toolchain download is blocked here, so `elan toolchain install` was served from the official `lean-4.36.0-linux.zip` GitHub release asset; Mathlib via `lake exe cache get`).
2. `python3 tracker/port_build.py check P0257 WORK --ready-only`: 42 of 47 built unchanged; M086136, M086328, M088129, M090000, M090566 failed. No reused-name warnings.
3. Fixed those 5 in `WORK/lean/src`; `check P0257 WORK --ready-only` again: **47 of 47 modules built**.
4. `lake env lean --run port/reused_audit.lean <47 modules>`: `reused-audit: 47 module(s), 0 hit(s)`; `port/islattice_audit.lean`: `islattice-audit: 47 module(s), 0 hit(s)`.
5. `python3 tracker/port_build.py diff P0257 WORK`, then `reproduce P0257 WORK OUT --ready-only --issue 32733`: all 14 parts match `parts.sha256`, all 47 packet and 118 import source hashes match, fresh tree with `lake --no-cache build +<Module>:olean` per module, every module `exit=0`, ending `== done: 47 of 47 modules built`.
6. `records P0257 WORK --ready-only --evidence <receipt URL> --notes notes.json`; `python3 tracker/validate_ports.py`: `Validated 15211 port records.` Added lines contain no `sorry`/`admit`/`axiom`/`implemented_by`/`native_decide`/`unsafe`.
